title: Neon Mother in Crystal Orb
description: A glowing glass sphere on a metallic stand contains a black silhouette of a mother holding her baby, set against a stylized tree with birds. Bright neon plasma-like tendrils in purple, cyan, and yellow branch from a base electrode toward three glowing yellow orbs inside the sphere.
prompt: A surreal glowing plasma globe on a metal stand, inside the transparent sphere a black silhouette of a mother cradling her baby stands before a bare tree with flying birds, bright purple and cyan electrical tendrils branch from a base electrode connecting to three luminous yellow orbs, dramatic lighting, reflective glass with water droplets, dark background, mystical atmosphere
